data.body: **[P2] Preserve the coalescing window for synchronous empty checkpoints.** `has_blocked_caller` is set solely from `completion_event`, so `QueuedOperation(None, event)` takes this 1 ms path. Concurrent resume coordinators can therefore be split across multiple empty API calls, making the 300-thread e2e scheduler-dependent. Track synchronous empty checkpoints separately and let the full poll window take precedence whenever one is present, including mixed batches; replace the short-empty unit test with standalone and mixed-batch coverage.
